args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary for June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- High SPF sunscreen
- Sunglasses
- Sun hat/cap
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for Hanauma Bay)

Clothing:
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Beach cover-ups
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Hiking boots/shoes (for Diamond Head hike)
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and beach activities)
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Evening attire (for the Luau on June 16)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - though rentals are available)
- Waterproof phone case/dry bag
- Camera with waterproof protection
- Reusable water bottle

Personal Items:
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)
- Medications
- Toiletries
- Insect repellent

Electronics:
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter if needed

Miscellaneous:
- Small backpack/day bag
- Cash and credit cards
- Shopping list for Ala Moana Center (June 19)
